task_summary: Dock apixaban into diverse NTF2-like backbones and design binding sequences

steps.title: Fetch NTF2-like protein structures from PDB
steps.description: Search PDB for NTF2-like domain structures (PFAM PF02136 or SCOP NTF2-like fold) with diverse pocket geometries. Select 3-5 structures spanning different pocket volumes, shapes, and electrostatic profiles. Download and prepare clean backbones (remove ligands, waters, keep only protein atoms).

steps.title: Characterize pocket geometries
steps.description: Compute pocket volumes, depths, and lining residue identities for each scaffold. Report on the diversity of the selected set.

steps.title: Obtain apixaban structure
steps.description: Get apixaban SMILES from PubChem (CID 10182969). Validate the structure and prepare an SDF file for docking.

steps.title: Dock apixaban into each NTF2-like backbone
steps.description: Run DiffDock-L blind docking of apixaban against each scaffold. Generate 40 samples per complex, ranked by confidence score. Extract top-ranked pose for each scaffold.

steps.title: Analyze docking results
steps.description: Compare binding poses across scaffolds — pocket occupancy, key interactions, confidence scores. Select the most promising complexes (top 2-3) for sequence design.

steps.title: Design sequences around docked apixaban
steps.description: For each selected complex, run LigandMPNN with ligand context enabled. Design sequences at multiple temperatures (0.1, 0.3, 0.5) to sample diversity. Redesign all residues within 8Å of the ligand; keep the scaffold core fixed.

steps.title: Analyze designed sequences
steps.description: Compare designed sequences across scaffolds. Report sequence recovery vs native, ligand confidence scores, and identify conserved binding motifs. Output threaded PDBs and FASTA files.

steps.title: Compile summary report
steps.description: Create a summary report with: scaffold pocket geometries, docking poses and confidence scores, designed sequences with ligand-confidence metrics, and recommendations for the best apixaban-binding designs. Include PyMOL-session files for visualization.

desired_outputs: NTF2-like scaffold set with pocket characterization (CSV)
Docked apixaban poses ranked by confidence (SDF + summary CSV)
Designed protein sequences with ligand-confidence scores (FASTA + threaded PDBs)

feasibility.rationale: NTF2-like proteins are well-represented in the PDB. DiffDock provides blind docking without a predefined pocket, making it suitable for diverse scaffolds. LigandMPNN handles small-molecule context for sequence design. The main limitations are that DiffDock predicts pose geometry (not binding affinity), and designed sequences require experimental validation.
